source_caption:
Taika Waititi wrote the iconic role of Ricky Baker specifically for Julian Dennison after directing the young actor in a brief New Zealand public service commercial. Recognizing his brilliant, deadpan comedic timing, Waititi tailored the entire script around his unique energy, capturing lightning in a bottle to create the highest-grossing Kiwi film in history.
⠀
Hunt for the Wilderpeople (2016), directed by Taika Waititi, starring Sam Neill, Julian Dennison, Rima Te Wiata. A defiant foster child and his cantankerous uncle trigger a hilarious national manhunt when they get stranded in the unforgiving New Zealand bush.

source_details.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
source_details.synopsis: Hunt for the Wilderpeople is a 2016 New Zealand adventure comedy film produced, written and directed by Taika Waititi, based on the 1986 novel Wild Pork and Watercress by Barry Crump. Sam Neill and Julian Dennison star as "Uncle" Hector and Ricky Baker: a father figure and foster son who become the targets of a manhunt after fleeing into the New Zealand bush. Hunt for the Wilderpeople premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on 22 January 2016. The film opened across New Zealand on 31 March 2016.
